segments.narration: Every year, utility companies in Georgia and South Carolina file billions in future grid construction — and they plan it blind to what their neighbors are building next door.

Co Grid compares 334 real filed projects from nine utilities — and finds where crews, corridors, and construction windows collide. Of nearly two thousand physical overlaps, eight hundred ninety-seven share a live build window.
segments.note: gentle pan across state, tier-colored corridor glows visible

segments.narration: Here on the Savannah River, Dominion Energy South Carolina and Georgia Power are rebuilding parallel corridors — tier one: literally touching, in the same 2026 build window.
Every opportunity is ranked — distance tier, shared timeline, and the actual filings behind it, with a snapshot drawn on real geography, not a cartoon.
